title: Chapter 216: Sorting Out The Spoils
content:
Chapter 216: Sorting Out The Spoils

At this time, it was already dark, and Wang Shuo immediately told everyone to go down and rest!

This trip to the Dragon King's underground palace was really fruitful!

When Wang Shuo returned to the meeting room, he couldn't wait to count the spoils.

The energy crystals he harvested barely equaled the loss of Wang Shuo's angry use of the water-proof sky curtain.

And more than 1,200 soul crystals were harvested.

Among all the spoils, Wang Shuo was most interested in two internal skills.

["Zhengyang Jin": Xuan-level lower-grade internal skills, a total of seven levels, each level of practice can increase basic attributes, all attributes +2, defense +5, attack +10, command value +2, internal force +200, can be attached to weapons, greatly increase damage, after the great success, can also increase the command value by 10 points. ]

[Evaluation: It is one of the most favorite skills of the elite soldiers of Black Dragon City. It is deeply loved by the majority of soldiers because of its mild internal force and wide application. Of course, the more important reason is the command value attribute it provides, which is a necessary condition for promotion to an officer. ]

Wang Shuo smiled in surprise. Compared with his "Dragon Spear Art" and "Zhengyang Jin", it is simply garbage.

Then Wang Shuo took out the "Black Dragon Sutra". This skill was dropped by the Black Dragon King, so it must be even more awesome.

["Black Dragon Sutra": Earth-level middle-grade skill, a total of nine levels. Each level of practice can increase basic attributes, all attributes +10, defense +20, attack power +50, internal force +500, internal force can be attached to skills and weapons, and each level of practice increases damage by 50%. ]

[Evaluation: It is difficult to practice, so don't try it easily! ]

After seeing the introduction, Wang Shuo breathed quickly and was ecstatic.

"That's it!" Wang Shuo was not frightened by the warning in the evaluation. With such great power, it is normal that the practice is difficult.

Wang Shuo hurriedly comprehended it. After trying for an hour, he didn't even touch the door!

It's really not easy to practice.

But Wang Shuo didn't give up and kept comprehending until the next morning.

"Oh, oh, oh..."

The sound of roosters crowing sounded.

Wang Shuo then put away the "Black Dragon Sutra" with dark circles under his eyes and was somewhat unwilling.

After breakfast, Wang Shuo called the core personnel of the territory to the meeting room.

It's time to reward them according to their merits.

Everyone knew it well, and they all looked very excited.

"Gong Zheng, Gong Ping, Gong Kai, Li Jianguo, Baili Liang come forward."

Wang Shuo took out 5 legion orders and issued them to 5 people respectively.

Although the corps was established before, it did not get the bonus of the legion order. Now this shortcoming can finally be made up.

Ayub was in charge of the Golden Fire Cavalry, Gong Zheng was in charge of the Shield Soldiers, Gong Ping was in charge of the Black Mountain Bandits, Gong Kai was in charge of the Archery Battalion, Li Jianguo was in charge of the Crossbow Battalion, and Baili Liang was in charge of the City Defense Army.

Wana Village officially joined the ranks of the regular army.

Wang Shuo took out the tiger talisman and said to the generals: "Our Wana Village's troops have begun to take shape. Let's think about it, what should we call our troops?"

"Black Mountain Legion."

"God Shooter Legion."

"Golden Legion."

...

Everyone started arguing, and they all wanted to use the characteristics of the corps they led to crown the name of the entire legion.

Just when everyone was arguing, military advisor Zou Yuanjie said: "Xuanjia Legion."

After hearing this, Wang Shuo was not very satisfied.

At this time, Duan Wenxi saw Wang Shuo in a red Chiyan armor, and smiled: "Boss, why not call it the Chiyan Legion!"

Wang Shuo looked down, thought about it carefully, and thought that this name was not bad.

"Okay, let's call it the Chiyan Legion."
